title: Rice/Paddy — Disease Management: Blast, Sheath Blight, BLB
content:
MAJOR DISEASES OF PADDY:

1. RICE BLAST (Magnaporthe oryzae) — Most Destructive:
Leaf blast symptoms: Diamond-shaped gray-white lesions with brown border.
Neck blast symptoms: Pale brown discoloration at neck — grain not filled, causes white ears.
Management:
- Leaf blast: Tricyclazole 75 WP @ 600 g/ha at first sign.
- Neck blast (preventive at boot leaf): Carbendazim 50 WP @ 500 g/ha.
- Isoprothiolane 40 EC @ 750 ml/ha.
Variety: Use Jyothi, Sindhu (moderately resistant for Karnataka).
Never apply excess N — promotes blast.

2. SHEATH BLIGHT (Rhizoctonia solani):
Symptoms: Oval water-soaked lesions on leaf sheath, grayish-white center.
Management: Validamycin 3L @ 2.5 ml/L. Hexaconazole 5 EC @ 1 ml/L. Propiconazole 25 EC @ 1 ml/L.

3. BACTERIAL LEAF BLIGHT (BLB — Xanthomonas oryzae):
Symptoms: Water-soaked wavy margins from leaf tip, yellow ooze (kresek in seedlings).
Management: No effective chemical. Use resistant varieties. Drain flood water. Reduce N dose.
Karnataka: Jyothi, IR-64 moderately susceptible — manage with nutrition.

4. BAKANAE (Foolish Seedling — Fusarium fujikuroi):
Symptoms: Abnormally tall, pale green seedlings, early death.
Management: Seed treatment — Carbendazim 0.1% soak 24h. Hot water treatment 52°C for 10 min.

5. BROWN SPOT (Cochliobolus miyabeanus):
Symptoms: Brown circular spots with gray center — associated with N/K deficiency.
Management: Improve nutrition (NPK). Edifenphos 50 EC @ 1 ml/L. Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2g/L.

BIOLOGICAL CONTROL:
- Pseudomonas fluorescens seed treatment @ 10g/kg reduces blast incidence.
- Trichoderma viride 4g/kg seed treatment reduces sheath blight.
